reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music transitions in Provincia! Previously, the colony music would hitch at the seams, but now our AI-authored loops feature a seamless crossfade that enhances your gaming experience. Check out the details in our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
